summary: Held the entire episode - the entry's thesis stayed intact throughout. Price ran to +131.75pts by t=9m and then oscillated in a wide but never-underwater range (+56 to +114pts) for the remaining 11 minutes; every dip was a giveback off a prior high, never a break below entry or below the prior swing structure, so no HA/PROPP/CLIMAX-against fire ever coincided with a genuine trend break. Next time I'd watch for the against-fires to cluster WHILE price closes below the local ldist_level/vwap structure (not just off a local high) - that combination, not giveback% alone, would be the real wrong-direction tell.
